gitPatchReason: N6.7.A is a material preflight/audit parent. Its DoD is actual-state inventario, scope, dependencies, risks, acceptance, rollback and test strategy; large functional implementation is explicitly out of scope.

included: inventario current EmpresaConfiguracion contract and API surface
Identify tenant-isolation gap before N6.7 implementation
Define acceptance, rollback and test strategy for the next implementation parent

actualState.empresa: Tenant root currently owns only Nombre and Activa; its domain documentation explicitly defers independent configuration to N6.7.
actualState.empresaConfiguracion: Rich business/system configuration exists as a separate singleton-style aggregate with commercial, fiscal, contact, branding, locale and legal fields, but it has no EmpresaId.
actualState.api: Authenticated GET/PUT/logo mutations are guarded by Configuracion Ver/Editar, while the public configuration endpoint is anonymous; all routes resolve the active singleton configuration without an EmpresaId parameter.
actualState.service: EmpresaConfiguracionService GetOrCreateAsync resolves repository.GetActivaAsync and creates one active configuration when absent; updates and logo operations act on that active configuration and audit the mutation.
actualState.frontend: Existing Empresa administration is identity/lifecycle oriented; tenant-specific rich configuration is not yet represented as an independent per-Empresa contract.

materialGap: N6.7 must move rich configuration from global active-singleton semantics to a tenant-owned contract without allowing cross-Empresa reads/writes or trusting an unverified tenant selector.
risks: Cross-tenant configuration bleed if EmpresaId is accepted without verified tenant context
Ambiguous migration of the existing singleton configuration into multiple Empresa records
Logo storage ownership and cleanup becoming cross-tenant unsafe
Anonymous public configuration semantics becoming ambiguous in multi-tenant mode
Breaking current consumers that assume a single active configuration
Audit records losing tenant attribution during migration
acceptanceForNextParent: Every protected configuration read/write is resolved from verified tenant context and rejects mismatched tenant scope fail-closed
Persisted rich configuration is uniquely associated to exactly one Empresa
No Empresa can read, mutate, replace or delete another Empresa's logo/configuration
Configuracion Ver/Editar remains enforced for protected operations
Migration/backfill from the singleton baseline is deterministic and test-covered
Public configuration semantics are explicit and cannot leak another tenant's data
Audit evidence attributes configuration mutations to the correct Empresa and actor
Existing N6.6 numbering and tenant guards remain regression-safe
rollback: This parent introduces evidence only. Rollback is removal of this immutable review artifact; no runtime, schema, secret, deployment or production state is changed.
